+# Daily Grind analytics
+
+The homepage loads `analytics.js` as a deferred script. It records one `page_view`
+and delegated `click` events, including timestamps, page paths, and element tags
+and IDs. Link clicks also include the destination path. Query strings, fragments,
+form values, and visible text are excluded.
+
+Configure the `ENDPOINT` constant in `analytics.js` for your collector (default:
+`/api/analytics`). The hosting backend must implement this endpoint; the static
+site does not include a collector. It receives JSON POST bodies of the form
+`{ "events": [{ "type": "page_view", "timestamp": 0, "path": "/" }] }`.
+
+Each event replaces the pending deferred request with the complete batch and
+restarts a 10-second quiet window. Native `fetchLater()` handles early navigation;
+unsupported browsers use a timer and flush when the page becomes hidden with a
+low-priority keepalive fetch. Native scheduling errors also use this fallback.
+Batches flush early at 100 events or before exceeding 48 KiB. Delivery is best
+effort, without retries, persistent storage, or blocking navigation.
+
+Run the isolated checks with `node --test analytics.test.cjs`. They use simulated
+DOM events and timers, without a browser or server.

+# Daily Grind
+
+The homepage loads `analytics.js` with a deferred script. It records one
+`page_view` per document load and delegated `click` events (including nested
+elements in links and buttons). Events include an ISO timestamp, page pathname,
+element tag, optional `data-analytics` label or element ID, and link destination
+pathname. Query strings, fragments, and visible or entered text are excluded.
+
+Events are sent together after 1 second without interactions, or after at most
+5 seconds of continuous activity. A batch is limited to 50 events. Hiding or
+leaving the page flushes pending events with `sendBeacon`, falling back to a
+keepalive fetch. Delivery is best effort; failures are swallowed without retries
+or persistent storage.
+
+The hosting service must implement `POST /api/analytics` (or change the script's
+`data-endpoint` in `index.html`). This static repository has no server receiver.
+Both transports send JSON with `Content-Type: application/json`:
+
+```json
+{
+  "events": [
+    { "type": "page_view", "timestamp": "2026-10-30T12:00:00.000Z", "page": "/" },
+    { "type": "click", "timestamp": "2026-10-30T12:00:00.500Z", "page": "/", "element": "a", "destination": "/order-online" }
+  ]
+}
+```
+
+Run the isolated client tests with `node --test analytics.test.cjs`; no server or
+browser is required.

+# The Daily Grind
+
+Static coffee homepage with a device-only encrypted delivery notebook.
+
+## Build and checks
+
+- `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`
+- `pnpm test` runs cryptographic round trips and corruption tests in Node, with no server.
+- `pnpm build` bundles the browser application and refreshes its SHA-384 integrity and CSP hash in `index.html`.
+
+Serve the repository as static files over HTTPS. The checked-in `assets/app.js` is ready to serve. Rebuild whenever changing application code; the document's integrity and CSP hashes must match the bundle. No third-party JavaScript is fetched at runtime.
+
+## Privacy and key lifecycle
+
+Every save encapsulates a fresh shared secret using ML-KEM-768 + X25519 (X-Wing). Native WebCrypto is capability-detected; a pinned, bundled noble implementation provides hybrid protection where native KEM APIs are unavailable. HKDF-SHA-256 binds the derived AES-256-GCM key to the protocol and envelope header. Each note has a fresh 96-bit IV and a 128-bit authentication tag. The version, suite, recipient ID, note ID and timestamp are authenticated as associated data.
+
+IndexedDB stores only encrypted note envelopes and the device recipient. Native recipient private keys are non-extractable CryptoKeys. For the portable implementation, the recipient secret key is encrypted under a non-extractable AES-GCM wrapping CryptoKey stored through IndexedDB structured cloning. Temporary byte buffers are cleared where possible; JavaScript strings and garbage collection cannot promise complete memory erasure. Recipient installation is atomic across tabs.
+
+Reveal decrypts locally and renders text with `textContent`. Revealed notes hide after 30 seconds or when the page is hidden; hiding the page also clears drafts. Saves replace the previous note, and Delete removes the saved ciphertext. Clearing browser site data permanently removes the recipient and note.
+
+**This is local storage, not delivery integration.** Notes are never transmitted or synced. Anyone using the same browser profile can reveal them. Non-extractable keys are not an authentication boundary against scripts running on this origin or a compromised device. There is no customer account isolation in this static repository.
+
+A real delivery integration requires an authenticated recipient public key, an authorized encrypted-envelope API, and recipient-side decryption in the delivery team's trusted application. Do not send this device's wrapping key or private recipient key to a backend. Deploy with HTTPS and appropriate host-level security headers; frame-ancestors and HSTS require HTTP headers and cannot be enforced with a meta element.

+import {
+  createRecipient,
+  publicRecipient,
+  encryptNote,
+  decryptNote,
+} from "./encryption.js";
+
+const form = document.querySelector("#notes-form");
+const fields = document.querySelector("#notes-fields");
+const input = document.querySelector("#delivery-note");
+const status = document.querySelector("#notes-status");
+const counter = document.querySelector("#character-count");
+const savedPanel = document.querySelector("#saved-note");
+const revealed = document.querySelector("#revealed-note");
+const revealButton = document.querySelector("#reveal-note");
+const saveLabel = document.querySelector("#save-label");
+const protectionLabel = document.querySelector(".active-badge");
+let database,
+  recipient,
+  hideTimer,
+  busy = false;
+
+function announce(message, error = false) {
+  status.textContent = message;
+  status.classList.toggle("error", error);
+}
+function hideNote() {
+  clearTimeout(hideTimer);
+  revealed.textContent = "";
+  revealed.hidden = true;
+  revealButton.textContent = "Reveal note";
+  revealButton.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
+}
+function setSaved(saved) {
+  savedPanel.hidden = !saved;
+  saveLabel.textContent = saved
+    ? "Encrypt & update note"
+    : "Encrypt & save note";
+  hideNote();
+}
+function clearDraft() {
+  input.value = "";
+  counter.textContent = "0 / 500";
+  hideNote();
+}
+function openDatabase() {
+  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+    const request = indexedDB.open("daily-grind-private-notes", 1);
+    request.onupgradeneeded = () => request.result.createObjectStore("vault");
+    request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
+    request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
+    request.onblocked = () => reject(new Error("Storage unavailable."));
+  });
+}
+function transact(mode, action) {
+  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+    const transaction = database.transaction("vault", mode);
+    let result;
+    transaction.oncomplete = () => resolve(result);
+    transaction.onerror = () => reject(transaction.error);
+    transaction.onabort = () =>
+      reject(transaction.error || new Error("Storage unavailable."));
+    action(transaction.objectStore("vault"), (value) => {
+      result = value;
+    });
+  });
+}
+const read = (key) =>
+  transact("readonly", (store, done) => {
+    store.get(key).onsuccess = (event) => done(event.target.result);
+  });
+// Atomic check-and-insert prevents competing tabs from replacing a recipient.
+const installRecipient = (candidate) =>
+  transact("readwrite", (store, done) => {
+    store.get("recipient").onsuccess = (event) => {
+      const existing = event.target.result;
+      if (existing) done(existing);
+      else {
+        store.put(candidate, "recipient");
+        done(candidate);
+      }
+    };
+  });
+async function run(operation) {
+  if (busy) return;
+  busy = true;
+  fields.disabled = true;
+  try {
+    await operation();
+  } catch {
+    hideNote();
+    announce(
+      "We couldn’t securely access this note. Nothing was sent. Please try again or check browser storage permissions.",
+      true,
+    );
+  } finally {
+    busy = false;
+    fields.disabled = false;
+  }
+}
+
+// Never submit plaintext, even if secure initialization is unavailable.
+form.addEventListener("submit", (event) => {
+  event.preventDefault();
+  if (!recipient || busy) return;
+  if (!input.value.trim()) {
+    input.setCustomValidity(
+      "Write a note before saving. Use Delete to remove a saved note.",
+    );
+    input.reportValidity();
+    return;
+  }
+  run(async () => {
+    const plaintext = input.value;
+    announce("Encrypting your note…");
+    const envelope = await encryptNote(publicRecipient(recipient), plaintext);
+    await transact("readwrite", (store) => store.put(envelope, "note"));
+    clearDraft();
+    setSaved(true);
+    announce(
+      "Your note is encrypted and saved on this device. It hasn’t been sent to a delivery team.",
+    );
+  });
+});
+input.addEventListener("input", () => {
+  input.setCustomValidity("");
+  counter.textContent = `${input.value.length} / 500`;
+});
+document.querySelector("#clear-note").addEventListener("click", () => {
+  clearDraft();
+  input.setCustomValidity("");
+  announce("Draft cleared. Any saved encrypted note is unchanged.");
+  input.focus();
+});
+revealButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
+  if (!revealed.hidden) {
+    hideNote();
+    return;
+  }
+  run(async () => {
+    const envelope = await read("note");
+    if (!envelope) {
+      setSaved(false);
+      announce("This note was removed in another tab.");
+      return;
+    }
+    const text = await decryptNote(recipient, envelope);
+    // User content is always rendered as text, never parsed as HTML.
+    revealed.textContent = text;
+    revealed.hidden = false;
+    revealButton.textContent = "Hide note";
+    revealButton.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
+    announce(
+      "Note revealed on this screen. It will hide automatically in 30 seconds.",
+    );
+    hideTimer = setTimeout(hideNote, 30000);
+  });
+});
+document.querySelector("#delete-note").addEventListener("click", () =>
+  run(async () => {
+    await transact("readwrite", (store) => store.delete("note"));
+    setSaved(false);
+    announce("Your encrypted note has been deleted from this device.");
+  }),
+);
+document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
+  if (document.hidden) {
+    clearDraft();
+  }
+});
+window.addEventListener("pagehide", clearDraft);
+
+async function initialize() {
+  try {
+    if (
+      !globalThis.isSecureContext ||
+      !globalThis.crypto?.subtle ||
+      !globalThis.indexedDB
+    ) {
+      throw new Error("Secure storage unavailable.");
+    }
+    database = await openDatabase();
+    database.onversionchange = () => {
+      database.close();
+      fields.disabled = true;
+      clearDraft();
+      announce(
+        "Secure storage changed in another tab. Reload to continue.",
+        true,
+      );
+    };
+    recipient = await read("recipient");
+    if (!recipient) recipient = await installRecipient(await createRecipient());
+    setSaved(Boolean(await read("note")));
+    fields.disabled = false;
+    protectionLabel.firstChild.textContent = "ACTIVE ";
+    announce(
+      "Encrypted on this device. Never sent without a delivery connection.",
+    );
+  } catch {
+    fields.disabled = true;
+    protectionLabel.textContent = "UNAVAILABLE";
+    announce(
+      "Secure notes are unavailable. Use HTTPS and allow browser storage to enable encryption.",
+      true,
+    );
+  }
+}
+initialize();

+import { ml_kem768_x25519 } from "@noble/post-quantum/hybrid.js";
+
+const encoder = new TextEncoder();
+const SUITE = "MLKEM768-X25519+HKDF-SHA256+AES-256-GCM";
+const random = (length) => crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(length));
+const encodeHeader = (header) =>
+  encoder.encode(
+    JSON.stringify([
+      header.version,
+      header.suite,
+      header.recipientId,
+      header.noteId,
+      header.createdAt,
+    ]),
+  );
+
+function supportsNativeHybrid() {
+  return (
+    typeof crypto.subtle.encapsulateBits === "function" &&
+    typeof crypto.subtle.decapsulateBits === "function" &&
+    globalThis.SubtleCrypto?.supports?.("generateKey", "MLKEM768-X25519") ===
+      true
+  );
+}
+
+// Persist CryptoKeys directly through IndexedDB structured cloning. The portable
+// implementation's secret key is wrapped with a non-extractable device key.
+export async function createRecipient({ native = true } = {}) {
+  if (native && supportsNativeHybrid()) {
+    try {
+      const keys = await crypto.subtle.generateKey("MLKEM768-X25519", false, [
+        "encapsulateBits",
+        "decapsulateBits",
+      ]);
+      return { id: crypto.randomUUID(), provider: "native", keys };
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (error.name !== "NotSupportedError") throw error;
+    }
+  }
+  const { publicKey, secretKey } = ml_kem768_x25519.keygen();
+  try {
+    const wrappingKey = await crypto.subtle.generateKey(
+      { name: "AES-GCM", length: 256 },
+      false,
+      ["encrypt", "decrypt"],
+    );
+    const iv = random(12);
+    const id = crypto.randomUUID();
+    const sealedSecretKey = await crypto.subtle.encrypt(
+      {
+        name: "AES-GCM",
+        iv,
+        additionalData: encoder.encode(`daily-grind-recipient-v1:${id}`),
+      },
+      wrappingKey,
+      secretKey,
+    );
+    return {
+      id,
+      provider: "portable",
+      publicKey,
+      wrappingKey,
+      iv,
+      sealedSecretKey,
+    };
+  } finally {
+    secretKey.fill(0);
+  }
+}
+
+async function deriveAesKey(secret, salt, header, usages) {
+  const bytes = new Uint8Array(secret);
+  try {
+    const material = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
+      "raw",
+      bytes,
+      "HKDF",
+      false,
+      ["deriveKey"],
+    );
+    return await crypto.subtle.deriveKey(
+      {
+        name: "HKDF",
+        hash: "SHA-256",
+        salt,
+        info: encoder.encode(
+          `daily-grind-delivery-notes-v1:${JSON.stringify(Array.from(encodeHeader(header)))}`,
+        ),
+      },
+      material,
+      { name: "AES-GCM", length: 256 },
+      false,
+      usages,
+    );
+  } finally {
+    bytes.fill(0);
+  }
+}
+
+// The sender only receives the public recipient identity, never a private key.
+export function publicRecipient(recipient) {
+  return {
+    id: recipient.id,
+    provider: recipient.provider,
+    publicKey:
+      recipient.provider === "native"
+        ? recipient.keys.publicKey
+        : recipient.publicKey,
+  };
+}
+
+export async function encryptNote(recipient, plaintext) {
+  if (
+    typeof plaintext !== "string" ||
+    !plaintext.trim() ||
+    plaintext.length > 500
+  ) {
+    throw new Error("Enter a note between 1 and 500 characters.");
+  }
+  const header = {
+    version: 1,
+    suite: SUITE,
+    recipientId: recipient.id,
+    noteId: crypto.randomUUID(),
+    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
+  };
+  let secret, capsule;
+  if (recipient.provider === "native") {
+    const result = await crypto.subtle.encapsulateBits(
+      "MLKEM768-X25519",
+      recipient.publicKey,
+    );
+    secret = result.sharedKey;
+    capsule = new Uint8Array(result.ciphertext);
+  } else {
+    const result = ml_kem768_x25519.encapsulate(recipient.publicKey);
+    secret = result.sharedSecret;
+    capsule = result.cipherText;
+  }
+  const salt = random(32);
+  const key = await deriveAesKey(secret, salt, header, ["encrypt"]);
+  const iv = random(12);

+import { test } from "node:test";
+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import {
+  createRecipient,
+  publicRecipient,
+  encryptNote,
+  decryptNote,
+} from "../src/encryption.js";
+
+for (const native of [false, true]) {
+  test(`hybrid encryption round trip (native preference: ${native})`, async () => {
+    const recipient = await createRecipient({ native });
+    const publicIdentity = publicRecipient(recipient);
+    assert.equal(publicIdentity.wrappingKey, undefined);
+    assert.equal(publicIdentity.keys, undefined);
+    const note =
+      "Side door, code 1234. Please don’t ring 🔔 <script>alert(1)</script>";
+    const envelope = await encryptNote(publicIdentity, note);
+    assert.equal(
+      await decryptNote(structuredClone(recipient), structuredClone(envelope)),
+      note,
+    );
+    assert.equal(JSON.stringify(envelope).includes("Side door"), false);
+    assert.equal(envelope.iv.length, 12);
+    assert.equal(envelope.capsule.length, 1120);
+    if (recipient.provider === "portable") {
+      assert.equal(recipient.wrappingKey.extractable, false);
+      assert.equal(recipient.secretKey, undefined);
+    } else {
+      assert.equal(recipient.keys.privateKey.extractable, false);
+    }
+  });
+}
+
+test("fresh encapsulation, salt, and IV on every save", async () => {
+  const recipient = publicRecipient(await createRecipient({ native: false }));
+  const a = await encryptNote(recipient, "Same note");
+  const b = await encryptNote(recipient, "Same note");
+  for (const field of ["capsule", "iv", "salt", "ciphertext"])
+    assert.notDeepEqual(a[field], b[field]);
+});
+
+test("rejects changed ciphertext, capsule, IV, salt, metadata and wrong recipients", async () => {
+  const recipient = await createRecipient({ native: false });
+  const envelope = await encryptNote(
+    publicRecipient(recipient),
+    "Gate code: 3210",
+  );
+  for (const field of ["ciphertext", "capsule", "iv", "salt"]) {
+    const changed = structuredClone(envelope);
+    changed[field][0] ^= 1;
+    await assert.rejects(decryptNote(recipient, changed));
+  }
+  for (const field of [
+    "version",
+    "suite",
+    "recipientId",
+    "noteId",
+    "createdAt",
+  ]) {
+    const changed = structuredClone(envelope);
+    changed.header[field] += "tampered";
+    await assert.rejects(decryptNote(recipient, changed));
+  }
+  await assert.rejects(
+    decryptNote(await createRecipient({ native: false }), envelope),
+  );
+});
+
+test("rejects empty and oversized notes", async () => {
+  const recipient = publicRecipient(await createRecipient({ native: false }));
+  for (const note of ["", "   ", "x".repeat(501)])
+    await assert.rejects(encryptNote(recipient, note));
+});

+# The Daily Grind
+
+A static coffee homepage with browser-encrypted delivery notes. Run `pnpm install` and `pnpm build` to regenerate the checked-in `app.js` bundle. Serve the static files over HTTPS (or localhost) for Web Crypto support. No server entrypoint is needed for the build.
+
+## Delivery notes
+
+The initial **local preview** creates recipient keypairs in memory. Notes are encrypted in the browser and can be revealed, deleted, or exported as JSON. There is no persistence, delivery API, order association, or automatic transmission. Reloading discards the preview private keys, so preview exports cannot be decrypted after reload. Private keys are never exported or placed in browser storage. JavaScript strings and internal browser crypto memory cannot be reliably zeroized; accessible temporary byte buffers are cleared where practical.
+
+For a real recipient, open **Recipient settings** and import public-key JSON supplied by a trusted delivery team. Verify the displayed SHA-256 fingerprint with the recipient through a trusted independent channel. Each protection mode has its own fingerprint; changing the selected mode updates the fingerprint. Imported-recipient notes can be exported but cannot be revealed on the sender's device. The receiving system must keep the matching private key and implement the envelope format below. Public keys alone do not authenticate their owner, and note encryption does not authenticate the sender.
+
+Public-key format: `{ "version": 1, "classical": "<Base64 X25519 public key>", "hybrid": "<Base64 X-Wing public key>", "quantum": "<Base64 ML-KEM-768 public key>" }`. The current recipient's public keys can be exported as a format example. Never include private keys in this file. The local preview deliberately offers no private-key export and is not intended as a durable recipient provisioning tool.
+
+## Cryptography and recipient integration
+
+- **Classic:** fresh ephemeral X25519 key agreement against the recipient public key. `encapsulation` contains the ephemeral public key.
+- **Hybrid:** the pinned `@noble/post-quantum` library's X-Wing construction (`ml_kem768_x25519`), combining X25519 and ML-KEM-768. `encapsulation` contains the hybrid KEM ciphertext.
+- **Post-quantum:** ML-KEM-768 encapsulation. `encapsulation` contains the KEM ciphertext.
+- **All modes:** HKDF-SHA-256 derives a non-extractable AES-256-GCM key from the shared secret, a random 32-byte salt, and the authenticated header as HKDF `info`. Encryption uses a random 12-byte nonce and a 128-bit authentication tag.
+
+The version 1 JSON envelope contains `version`, `mode`, `algorithm`, `cipher`, `kdf`, `recipient`, `salt`, `nonce`, `encapsulation`, and `ciphertext`. Binary fields are standard Base64. `recipient` is the lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 fingerprint of the selected raw public key. `ciphertext` includes the appended GCM authentication tag. No plaintext, shared secrets, or private keys are in the envelope.
+
+The AES-GCM additional authenticated data is UTF-8 JSON with these fields **in this exact order**: `context` (`daily-grind/delivery-note/v1`), `version`, `mode`, `algorithm`, `cipher`, `kdf`, `recipient`, `salt`, `nonce`, `encapsulation`. See `authenticatedHeader` in `src/crypto.js`. Decryption rejects unsupported parameters and recipient fingerprints, reconstructs the shared secret using the corresponding recipient private key, derives the key with the same HKDF inputs, and verifies the GCM tag before releasing plaintext. The exported `openNote` function documents the receiving operation. A production receiving endpoint should additionally enforce message size limits, access controls, recipient key rotation, and appropriate replay handling.
+
+Cryptography implementation: https://github.com/paulmillr/noble-post-quantum and https://github.com/paulmillr/noble-curves. Dependencies are pinned and bundled locally; crypto code is not fetched from a runtime CDN.
+
+## Verification
+
+`pnpm build` bundles the browser module. `pnpm test` runs Node-only cryptographic tests covering all three modes, Unicode round-trips, fresh key establishment, tampering, mismatched recipients, public-key handoff, and invalid inputs. The test suite was added but not run during implementation under the requested build-only verification constraint. No browser verification or development/preview server was used.

+export async function openNote(envelope, recipient) {

@@ -0,0 +1,77 @@
+import test from 'node:test';
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import { MODES, createRecipient, destroyRecipient, publicKeys, importRecipient, sealNote, openNote, fromBase64, toBase64 } from '../src/crypto.js';
+
+for (const mode of Object.keys(MODES)) {
+  test(`${mode}: encrypt and authenticate a Unicode delivery note`, async () => {
+    const recipient = createRecipient();
+    try {
+      const note = 'Gate: 0427. Leave beside the café door ☕';
+      const envelope = await sealNote(note, mode, recipient);
+      assert.equal(await openNote(envelope, recipient), note);
+      assert.equal(JSON.stringify(envelope).includes(note), false);
+      assert.equal(fromBase64(envelope.nonce).length, 12);
+      assert.equal(fromBase64(envelope.salt).length, 32);
+      assert.equal(fromBase64(envelope.ciphertext).length, new TextEncoder().encode(note).length + 16);
+      const second = await sealNote(note, mode, recipient);
+      assert.notEqual(second.nonce, envelope.nonce);
+      assert.notEqual(second.salt, envelope.salt);
+      assert.notEqual(second.encapsulation, envelope.encapsulation);
+    } finally { destroyRecipient(recipient); }
+  });
+
+  test(`${mode}: reject ciphertext, key-establishment, and metadata tampering`, async () => {
+    const recipient = createRecipient();
+    try {
+      const envelope = await sealNote('Private gate code 0427', mode, recipient);
+      for (const field of ['ciphertext', 'salt', 'nonce', 'encapsulation']) {
+        const bytes = fromBase64(envelope[field]);
+        bytes[0] ^= 1;
+        await assert.rejects(openNote({ ...envelope, [field]: toBase64(bytes) }, recipient));
+      }
+      await assert.rejects(openNote({ ...envelope, recipient: '0'.repeat(64) }, recipient));
+      await assert.rejects(openNote({ ...envelope, version: 2 }, recipient));
+      await assert.rejects(openNote({ ...envelope, cipher: 'AES-CBC' }, recipient));
+      await assert.rejects(openNote({ ...envelope, algorithm: 'another-algorithm' }, recipient));
+      const wrongRecipient = createRecipient();
+      try { await assert.rejects(openNote(envelope, wrongRecipient)); }
+      finally { destroyRecipient(wrongRecipient); }
+    } finally { destroyRecipient(recipient); }
+  });
+
+  test(`${mode}: export only public keys and encrypt for an imported recipient`, async () => {
+    const original = createRecipient();
+    try {
+      const exported = publicKeys(original);
+      assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(exported).sort(), ['classical', 'hybrid', 'quantum', 'version']);
+      const imported = importRecipient(JSON.stringify(exported));
+      assert.equal(imported.local, false);
+      for (const key of Object.values(imported.keys)) assert.equal(key.secretKey, undefined);
+      const envelope = await sealNote('Deliver to the side door', mode, imported);
+      assert.equal(await openNote(envelope, original), 'Deliver to the side door');
+      await assert.rejects(openNote(envelope, imported));
+    } finally { destroyRecipient(original); }
+  });
+}
+
+test('reject invalid note input, unknown modes, and malformed recipient keys', async () => {
+  const recipient = createRecipient();
+  try {
+    await assert.rejects(sealNote('   ', 'hybrid', recipient));
+    await assert.rejects(sealNote('a'.repeat(501), 'hybrid', recipient));
+    await assert.rejects(sealNote('note', '__proto__', recipient));
+    assert.throws(() => importRecipient('not JSON'));
+    assert.throws(() => importRecipient('{"version":2}'));
+    const exported = publicKeys(recipient);
+    assert.throws(() => importRecipient(JSON.stringify({ ...exported, secretKey: 'do not accept' })));
+    assert.throws(() => importRecipient(JSON.stringify({ ...exported, classical: toBase64(new Uint8Array(32)) })));
+    assert.throws(() => importRecipient(JSON.stringify({ ...exported, quantum: 'invalid!' })));
+    assert.throws(() => importRecipient(JSON.stringify({ ...exported, hybrid: 'AAAA' })));
+  } finally { destroyRecipient(recipient); }
+});
+
+test('clear temporary private key arrays when a recipient is discarded', () => {
+  const recipient = createRecipient();
+  destroyRecipient(recipient);
+  for (const keys of Object.values(recipient.keys)) assert.ok(keys.secretKey.every(byte => byte === 0));
+});

+# The Daily Grind
+
+## Script performance diagnostics
+
+`index.html` loads `script-diagnostics.js` with `defer`. In browsers supporting
+the Long Animation Frames API, it observes frames longer than 50 ms, including
+buffered frames from before the monitor loaded. It accumulates script execution
+time by source URL throughout the page visit. It does not send data anywhere.
+
+Use the page normally with the developer console open. Scripts with more than
+100 ms of cumulative execution time in long frames appear automatically in a
+table, sorted with the largest contributors first. Output is batched at most
+once per second while new script entries arrive. No sample slow scripts are
+added to the site.
+
+Console commands:
+
+```js
+scriptDiagnostics.supported     // Whether this browser supports attribution
+scriptDiagnostics.report()      // Print and return scripts totaling >100 ms
+scriptDiagnostics.report(0)     // Print all attributed scripts with execution time
+scriptDiagnostics.getSummary()  // Return a snapshot without logging
+scriptDiagnostics.reset()       // Clear accumulated results before an interaction
+scriptDiagnostics.stop()        // Disconnect monitoring; keep collected results
+```
+
+`totalDuration` is cumulative execution time, `longestDuration` is the longest
+observed invocation, `count` is the number of attributed invocations, and
+`forcedLayoutDuration` is time spent in forced style/layout within those
+invocations. All durations are milliseconds. Investigate the highest totals
+first, especially third-party code and repeated expensive handlers.
+
+These timings cover script work in long animation frames, not every execution
+or script download time. Attribution may omit cross-origin scripts or use an
+empty source URL; empty URLs are grouped as inline or unattributed. A blank
+report does not prove the page is fast. The current page has no other scripts.
+Unsupported browsers leave the site working and expose `supported: false`;
+use a supporting Chrome or Edge browser to collect results. Reload to restart
+monitoring after calling `stop()`.

+# Script performance diagnostics
+
+Open any page with `?scriptDiagnostics=1` (or append `&scriptDiagnostics=1`
+to an existing query). Open the developer console to see a table one second
+after load. After using menus, scrolling, or other interactions, run
+`scriptDiagnostics.report()` for updated results. Run `scriptDiagnostics.stop()`
+to flush and disconnect observers. Reload without the parameter to disable.
+
+The current page has no application or third-party scripts. The profiler itself
+may appear in the resource table. Put future scripts after the diagnostics tag
+in the head so collection starts early. Keep this file available at
+`/script-diagnostics.js` when deploying the static site.
+
+- `slowFrameScriptMs`, `slowFrameCalls`, and `maxCallMs` identify script work
+  observed in long animation frames. Sort order prioritizes that duration, then
+  the slowest load. `forcedLayoutMs` highlights expensive synchronous layout.
+- `requests`, `totalLoadMs`, and `maxLoadMs` describe script resource fetches,
+  not execution. Overlapping loads must not be added to estimate page delay.
+- `observedTransferBytes` is the reported transfer size; zero may mean cache
+  use or restricted cross-origin information, rather than an empty script.
+- `frameBlockingMs` is blocking time across entire slow frames. It is not
+  assigned to individual scripts. `unattributedFrames` counts frames without
+  script attribution; rendering and browser work can also cause delays.
+
+Execution attribution requires the [Long Animation Frames API](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/web-platform/long-animation-frames).
+It does not measure every execution, short script contributions may be omitted,
+and cross-origin or inline source information may be unavailable. Use these
+results to find candidates for investigation, not as proof of causality.
+Unsupported browsers still report available script resource timings via
+[Resource Timing](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/PerformanceResourceTiming).
+Resource buffers can omit older loads. Collection is local, stores no history,
+strips URL query strings and fragments, merges sources with the same origin and
+path, and retains at most 200 sources (`dropped` counts omitted observations).
+No requests are made to an analytics service. The diagnostics file is fetched on
+every visit but returns immediately unless explicitly enabled.

+# INP diagnostics
+
+The page loads the self-hosted attribution build of Google's `web-vitals` 6.2.3
+from `scripts/vendor/`. Its Apache 2.0 license is included alongside it. The file
+is the unmodified `dist/web-vitals.attribution.js` from the published npm package:
+https://registry.npmjs.org/web-vitals/-/web-vitals-6.2.3.tgz.
+No build step or runtime CDN request is required.
+
+Reports include INP in milliseconds, its rating, input delay, processing duration,
+presentation delay, the interaction's stable target label and the longest
+overlapping script's source/function/position and phase. They also include forced
+style/layout work within that script and rendering style/layout costs across the
+overlapping long animation frames.
+
+- Large `inputDelay`: investigate work already blocking the main thread.
+- Large `processingDuration`: investigate interaction handlers and their scripts.
+- Large `presentationDelay`: investigate rendering, CSS invalidation and layout.
+- Large forced style/layout durations: investigate synchronous DOM reads after writes.
+
+These are investigation clues, not proof that a script caused all of the delay.
+Rendering frame totals can include work outside the interaction window. Separate
+style/layout timings are `null` when unavailable; the combined
+`totalStyleAndLayoutDuration` and `forcedStyleAndLayoutDuration` provide older
+LoAF implementations' measurements. Browsers without LoAF still report available
+INP phases. Browsers without Event Timing cannot provide INP; no substitute score
+is fabricated. A visit without a qualifying interaction may produce no report.
+
+## Local diagnostics
+
+Slow INP reports are logged as console warnings. Append `?inp-debug` (or
+`&inp-debug` when the URL already has a query) to log every INP candidate change.
+This does not report every interaction. Normal reports are emitted when the page
+is hidden, and continue after a back/forward cache restore. No polling or DOM
+updates are used for diagnostics.
+
+Each report also emits a `performance:inp` event on `window`, with the plain JSON
+report in `event.detail`, for integration with existing analytics.
+`data-inp-target` attributes identify controls without collecting their text,
+form values or destination URLs. Script URL query strings and fragments are removed.
+
+## Field reporting
+
+Set `data-inp-endpoint` on the module script in `index.html` to your real analytics
+collector URL. This static project has no collector, so the default empty value
+does not send network requests. The collector must accept POST bodies containing
+JSON with content type `text/plain;charset=UTF-8`. For a cross-origin collector,
+configure its CORS policy for the fetch fallback and allow it in your CSP.
+
+Reports use `sendBeacon`, falling back to `fetch` with `keepalive` if unavailable,
+rejected, or throwing. Delivery is best effort. Upsert by metric `id`: multiple
+reports can occur within a visit, so do not count each as a separate visit. A
+bfcache restore receives a new metric ID. Aggregate final values at the 75th
+percentile across visits; good INP is at most 200 ms, poor INP exceeds 500 ms.

+# Passkey management integration
+
+The supplied checkout is static and has no authentication backend. The new UI is available at `/` and `/account/`; the original coffee landing page is preserved at `/home.html`.
+
+When `GET /api/account/passkeys` returns 404, or an HTML static-host fallback, the UI clearly labels itself **Preview account**. Preview credentials are samples persisted under `daily-grind.passkeys-preview.v1` in localStorage. Reset restores the samples. Preview never invokes WebAuthn or changes real credentials. Other service errors do not fall back to preview.
+
+## Authenticated API
+
+Connect these same-origin endpoints to the existing identity provider before treating this as production account management:
+
+- `GET /api/account/passkeys`: return the authenticated customer's complete credential snapshot.
+- `PATCH /api/account/passkeys/:id`: accept `{ "name": "My laptop" }`, trim and validate a name of 1–60 characters, persist it, and return the updated complete snapshot.
+- `DELETE /api/account/passkeys/:id`: revoke the owned credential atomically and return the updated complete snapshot. Return 409 if deletion would remove the last available sign-in method.
+
+Every successful response must use `Content-Type: application/json` and `Cache-Control: no-store`, with this shape:
+
+```json
+{
+  "authenticated": true,
+  "complete": true,
+  "rpId": "coffee.example.com",
+  "userId": "Y3VzdG9tZXItMTIz",
+  "displayName": "Alex",
+  "csrfToken": "session-bound-csrf-token",
+  "hasAlternativeSignIn": false,
+  "passkeys": [
+    {
+      "id": "Y3JlZGVudGlhbC0xMjM",
+      "name": "MacBook Pro",
+      "provider": "iCloud Keychain",
+      "deviceType": "platform",
+      "createdAt": "2026-09-12T10:00:00Z",
+      "lastUsedAt": "2026-10-30T10:00:00Z",
+      "current": true,
+      "canDelete": true
+    }
+  ]
+}
+```
+
+`userId` must be the base64url-encoded WebAuthn **user handle**, not an arbitrary database ID or email. Credential `id` values are the base64url-encoded raw WebAuthn credential IDs. `rpId` is the actual relying-party domain. `deviceType` can be `platform`, `phone`, or `securityKey`; unknown types use a generic key icon. Dates use ISO 8601. `current` means the credential used for this session, not proof that the credential belongs exclusively to this device. Omit optional display metadata if unknown. `canDelete: false` disables deletion confirmation for a protected key.
+
+The server must authenticate every request, scope credential access to the signed-in customer, reject cross-account IDs, check request origin and the session-bound `X-CSRF-Token` on mutations, and enforce last-sign-in-method protection atomically. Client guards are only UX. Return 401 for unauthenticated sessions, 403 for failed CSRF validation, and 409 for conflicts. Never redirect these API requests to an HTML sign-in page. Mutations must return JSON snapshots, not 204 responses.
+
+## Browser authenticator synchronization
+
+After an authenticated list load or confirmed deletion, the UI feature-detects `PublicKeyCredential.signalAllAcceptedCredentials` in a secure context. It passes the server's complete remaining credential IDs and WebAuthn user handle. Never paginate or filter this snapshot: omitted credentials can be removed by the authenticator. `complete: true` explicitly attests to this server contract. A successful signal requests synchronization; it does not guarantee that a provider has updated its stored credentials.
+
+No signal occurs for preview data, failed mutations, invalid snapshots, or passkey renames. Renames affect the account's credential label, not the WebAuthn user's display name. `signalCurrentUserDetails` would change user identity metadata and is inappropriate for renaming individual keys.
+
+Unsupported browsers and signal failures preserve the successful server deletion and explain how to remove stale credentials manually. A failed signal can be retried without repeating the deletion. The frontend does not create, sign in with, or export passkeys.
+
+Signal API reference: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/PublicKeyCredential/signalAllAcceptedCredentials_static

+
+## Passkeys and account settings
+
+Sign in with a password or a passkey at `/devtools-times/signin`. New readers
+create an account at `/devtools-times/signup` and can then register a passkey.
+Signed-in readers can add, rename, or remove passkeys and edit their display name
+at `/devtools-times/account`. The password service remains the existing Times CDN
+API; passwords and its access tokens are never stored by this app.
+
+Passkeys use native WebAuthn browser APIs with JSON/capability polyfills and
+[SimpleWebAuthn server verification](https://simplewebauthn.dev/docs/packages/server).
+Authentication supports discoverable credentials and conditional autofill.
+Registration requires discoverable credentials; the signup promotion requests a
+platform authenticator, while settings also permits external security keys.
+
+Challenges expire after five minutes, are bound to the browser session and
+operation, and are consumed once. Account sessions expire after 24 hours. Sensitive
+changes require verification within the last five minutes; passkey reauthentication
+requires user verification and only permits the signed-in account's credentials.
+A password fallback is available. Credential signals keep supported password
+managers in sync; a signaling failure does not fail an already completed change.
+
+Configure the following environment variables for your deployment:
+
+| Variable | Default | Purpose |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `PASSKEY_ORIGIN` | Astro `site` origin; localhost uses the request origin | Exact HTTPS public origin, including a nonstandard port if used. |
+| `PASSKEY_RP_ID` | Configured origin's hostname | Stable passkey domain, without protocol, port, or path. |
+| `AUTH_STORE_PATH` | `.data/auth.json` | Persistent writable path for account records, public keys, counters, metadata, and pending challenges. |
+
+Use HTTPS in production. Keep the RP ID stable: existing passkeys are tied to it.
+The default file store serializes transactions and atomically replaces the data
+file. It supports one Node process with persistent disk. For replicated or
+ephemeral deployments, replace it with a shared transactional database and configure
+Astro's session driver to use shared durable storage. Preserve both stores across
+releases; back up account and credential records. The default Astro Node adapter
+stores sessions under `.astro/sessions`.
+
+Provider names and icons are a local snapshot of the community-maintained
+[passkey AAGUID registry](https://github.com/passkeydeveloper/passkey-authenticator-aaguids).
+They are display hints only and are never used for access decisions. Unknown
+providers use a generic key icon. Provider logos belong to their respective owners.
+
+Validation: `pnpm run build` builds without starting the application. `pnpm exec
+astro check` performs static type checking; the repository currently also has
+unrelated existing errors in article images, content IDs, and the flyout menu.

@@ -0,0 +1,90 @@
+import type { AccountData, AccountUser } from './auth-types';
+import type { PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptionsJSON, PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptionsJSON } from '@simplewebauthn/server';
+
+const apiBase = `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}api/auth/`;
+export class ApiError extends Error {
+  constructor(message: string, public status: number, public code?: string) { super(message); }
+}
+export async function authApi<T>(path: string, body?: unknown, method = 'POST', signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<T> {
+  const response = await fetch(`${apiBase}${path}`, {
+    method, credentials: 'same-origin', cache: 'no-store', signal,
+    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+    ...(method !== 'GET' ? { body: JSON.stringify(body ?? {}) } : {}),
+  });
+  const data = await response.json();
+  if (!response.ok) throw new ApiError(data.error || 'The request failed. Please try again.', response.status, data.code);
+  return data;
+}
+
+type ModernCredential = PublicKeyCredential & { toJSON(): { id: string } };
+type ModernWebAuthn = typeof PublicKeyCredential & {
+  getClientCapabilities(): Promise<Record<string, boolean>>;
+  parseCreationOptionsFromJSON(options: PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptionsJSON): PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptions;
+  parseRequestOptionsFromJSON(options: PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptionsJSON): PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptions;
+  signalUnknownCredential?: (options: { rpId: string; credentialId: string }) => Promise<void>;
+  signalAllAcceptedCredentials?: (options: { rpId: string; userId: string; allAcceptedCredentialIds: string[] }) => Promise<void>;
+  signalCurrentUserDetails?: (options: { rpId: string; userId: string; name: string; displayName: string }) => Promise<void>;
+};
+const webauthn = () => PublicKeyCredential as ModernWebAuthn;
+export interface PasskeyCapabilities { supported: boolean; create: boolean; conditional: boolean }
+export async function passkeyCapabilities(): Promise<PasskeyCapabilities> {
+  const unavailable = { supported: false, create: false, conditional: false };
+  if (!window.isSecureContext || !window.PublicKeyCredential || !navigator.credentials) return unavailable;
+  try {
+    await import('webauthn-polyfills');
+    const capabilities = await webauthn().getClientCapabilities();
+    return { supported: true, create: !!(capabilities.passkeyPlatformAuthenticator ?? capabilities.userVerifyingPlatformAuthenticator) && !!capabilities.conditionalGet,
+      conditional: !!capabilities.conditionalGet };
+  } catch { return unavailable; }
+}
+export function passkeyError(error: unknown): string {
+  if (error instanceof DOMException) {
+    if (error.name === 'NotAllowedError') return 'The passkey request was canceled or timed out. You can try again or use your password.';
+    if (error.name === 'InvalidStateError') return 'A passkey already exists in this password manager. Use another device or provider to add a different one.';
+    if (error.name === 'AbortError') return 'The passkey request was canceled. Please try again.';
+    if (error.name === 'SecurityError') return 'Passkeys are unavailable on this address. Use the secure website or sign in with your password.';
+  }
+  return error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Something went wrong. Please try again.';
+}
+const bestEffort = async (signal: () => Promise<void> | undefined) => { try { await signal(); } catch { /* Password-manager sync must not interrupt a completed action. */ } };
+
+export async function registerPasskey(promotion = false, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<AccountData> {
+  const options = await authApi<PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptionsJSON>('passkeys/register/options', { promotion }, 'POST', signal);
+  const credential = await navigator.credentials.create({ publicKey: webauthn().parseCreationOptionsFromJSON(options), signal }) as ModernCredential | null;
+  if (!credential) throw new Error('No passkey was created. Please try again.');
+  const encoded = credential.toJSON();
+  try {
+    return await authApi<AccountData>('passkeys/register/verify', { credential: encoded, challenge: options.challenge }, 'POST', signal);
+  } catch (error) {
+    await bestEffort(() => webauthn().signalUnknownCredential?.({ rpId: options.rp.id!, credentialId: encoded.id }));
+    throw error;
+  }
+}
+export async function authenticatePasskey(reauthenticate = false, conditional = false, signal?: AbortSignal) {
+  const flow = reauthenticate ? 'reauthenticate' : 'authenticate';
+  const options = await authApi<PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptionsJSON>(`passkeys/${flow}/options`, {}, 'POST', signal);
+  const credential = await navigator.credentials.get({
+    publicKey: webauthn().parseRequestOptionsFromJSON(options), signal,
+    ...(conditional ? { mediation: 'conditional' as CredentialMediationRequirement } : {}),
+  }) as ModernCredential | null;
+  if (!credential) throw new Error('No passkey was selected. Please try again.');
+  const encoded = credential.toJSON();
+  try {
+    return await authApi<{ user: AccountUser }>(`passkeys/${flow}/verify`, { credential: encoded, challenge: options.challenge }, 'POST', signal);
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (!reauthenticate && error instanceof ApiError && error.code === 'UNKNOWN_CREDENTIAL' && error.status === 404) {
+      await bestEffort(() => webauthn().signalUnknownCredential?.({ rpId: options.rpId!, credentialId: encoded.id }));
+    }
+    throw error;
+  }
+}
+export async function syncPasskeys(data: AccountData) {
+  if (!window.PublicKeyCredential) return;
+  await bestEffort(() => webauthn().signalAllAcceptedCredentials?.({ rpId: data.rpId, userId: data.user.id,
+    allAcceptedCredentialIds: data.passkeys.map(p => p.id) }));
+}
+export async function syncUserDetails(data: AccountData) {
+  if (!window.PublicKeyCredential) return;
+  await bestEffort(() => webauthn().signalCurrentUserDetails?.({ rpId: data.rpId, userId: data.user.id,
+    name: data.user.username, displayName: data.user.displayName }));
+}

+++ b/src/lib/server/auth-store.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,59 @@
+import { mkdir, readFile, rename, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
+import { dirname, resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
+import type { AccountUser } from '../auth-types';
+import type { WebAuthnCredential } from '@simplewebauthn/server';
+
+export interface StoredPasskey {
+  id: string;
+  userId: string;
+  publicKey: string;
+  counter: number;
+  transports: WebAuthnCredential['transports'];
+  aaguid: string;
+  name: string;
+  deviceType: string;
+  backedUp: boolean;
+  registeredAt: number;
+  lastUsedAt?: number;
+}
+export interface Challenge {
+  challenge: string;
+  binding?: string;
+  purpose: 'register' | 'authenticate' | 'reauthenticate';
+  userId?: string;
+  rpId: string;
+  origin: string;
+  expiresAt: number;
+  requireUserVerification: boolean;
+}
+interface AuthStore {
+  users: AccountUser[];
+  passkeys: StoredPasskey[];
+  challenges: Challenge[];
+}
+
+// A durable single-process store for this sample app. Use a shared transactional
+// database (and shared session storage) when deploying multiple instances.
+const storePath = resolve(process.env.AUTH_STORE_PATH || '.data/auth.json');
+let queue: Promise<unknown> = Promise.resolve();
+export function authTransaction<T>(operation: (store: AuthStore) => T | Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
+  const next = queue.then(async () => {
+    let store: AuthStore;
+    try {
+      store = JSON.parse(await readFile(storePath, 'utf8'));
+    } catch (error) {
+      if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code !== 'ENOENT') throw error;
+      store = { users: [], passkeys: [], challenges: [] };
+    }
+    store.challenges = store.challenges.filter(c => c.expiresAt > Date.now());
+    const result = await operation(store);
+    await mkdir(dirname(storePath), { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
+    const temporary = `${storePath}.${randomUUID()}.tmp`;
+    await writeFile(temporary, JSON.stringify(store), { mode: 0o600 });
+    await rename(temporary, storePath);
+    return result;
+  });
+  queue = next.catch(() => {});
+  return next;
+}

--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/lib/server/auth.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,99 @@
+import type { APIContext } from 'astro';
+import { randomBytes } from 'node:crypto';
+import { authTransaction, type Challenge } from './auth-store';
+import type { AccountUser } from '../auth-types';
+
+export class AuthError extends Error {
+  constructor(message: string, public status = 400, public code?: string) { super(message); }
+}
+export const json = (data: unknown, status = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(data), {
+  status, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' },
+});
+export function relyingParty(request: Request) {
+  const configured = process.env.PASSKEY_ORIGIN || import.meta.env.SITE;
+  const requestUrl = new URL(request.url);
+  const local = ['localhost', '127.0.0.1', '[::1]'].includes(requestUrl.hostname);
+  const origin = new URL(local && !process.env.PASSKEY_ORIGIN ? requestUrl.origin : configured).origin;
+  return { origin, rpId: process.env.PASSKEY_RP_ID || new URL(origin).hostname };
+}
+export function sameOrigin(request: Request) {
+  const { origin } = relyingParty(request);
+  if (request.headers.get('Origin') !== origin) throw new AuthError('This request must come from The DevTools Times.', 403);
+  if (!request.headers.get('Content-Type')?.startsWith('application/json')) throw new AuthError('Expected a JSON request.', 415);
+}
+export async function currentUser(context: Pick<APIContext, 'session'>) {
+  const id = await context.session?.get('authUserId');
+  if (typeof id !== 'string') return undefined;
+  const expiresAt = await context.session?.get('authExpiresAt');
+  if (typeof expiresAt !== 'number' || expiresAt < Date.now()) return undefined;
+  return authTransaction(store => store.users.find(u => u.id === id));
+}
+export async function requireUser(context: APIContext) {
+  const user = await currentUser(context);
+  if (!user) throw new AuthError('Please sign in to continue.', 401);
+  return user;
+}
+export async function requireRecent(context: APIContext) {
+  const verifiedAt = await context.session?.get('verifiedAt');
+  if (typeof verifiedAt !== 'number' || Date.now() - verifiedAt > 5 * 60_000) {
+    throw new AuthError('Verify your identity to make this change.', 403, 'REAUTH_REQUIRED');
+  }
+}
+export async function signIn(context: APIContext, user: AccountUser, userVerified = true) {
+  if (!context.session) throw new AuthError('Sessions are unavailable.', 503);
+  await context.session.regenerate();
+  context.session.set('authBinding', randomBytes(32).toString('base64url'));
+  context.session.set('authUserId', user.id);
+  context.session.set('authExpiresAt', Date.now() + 24 * 60 * 60_000);
+  context.session.set('verifiedAt', userVerified ? Date.now() : 0);
+}
+export async function rememberUser(username: string) {
+  return authTransaction(store => {
+    let user = store.users.find(u => u.username === username);
+    if (!user) {
+      user = { id: randomBytes(32).toString('base64url'), username, displayName: username };
+      store.users.push(user);
+    }
+    return user;
+  });
+}
+export async function passwordRequest(action: 'login' | 'register', username: string, password: string) {
+  let response: Response;
+  try {
+    response = await fetch(`https://us-central1-web-devrel-apps.cloudfunctions.net/times_cdn/api/${action}`, {
+      method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+      body: JSON.stringify({ username, password }), signal: AbortSignal.timeout(15_000),
+    });
+  } catch { throw new AuthError('The sign-in service is unavailable. Please try again.', 503); }
+  if (!response.ok) {
+    throw new AuthError(action === 'login' ? 'The username or password is incorrect.' : 'Could not create your account. Try another username and a password with at least 8 characters and a number.', 400);
+  }
+}
+export async function saveChallenge(context: APIContext, challenge: Challenge) {
+  if (!context.session) throw new AuthError('Sessions are unavailable.', 503);
+  let binding = await context.session.get('authBinding');
+  if (!binding) {
+    binding = randomBytes(32).toString('base64url');
+    context.session.set('authBinding', binding);
+  }
+  await authTransaction(store => {
+    // Bound storage per session, while allowing requests from multiple tabs.
+    const pending = store.challenges.filter(c => c.binding === binding);
+    if (pending.length >= 10) {
+      const oldest = pending[0];
+      store.challenges = store.challenges.filter(c => c !== oldest);
+    }
+    store.challenges.push({ ...challenge, binding });
+  });
+}
+export async function takeChallenge(context: APIContext, purpose: Challenge['purpose'], value: unknown) {
+  const binding = await context.session?.get('authBinding');
+  const challenge = await authTransaction(store => {
+    const index = typeof value === 'string' && binding
+      ? store.challenges.findIndex(c => c.challenge === value && c.binding === binding && c.purpose === purpose)
+      : -1;
+    return index === -1 ? undefined : store.challenges.splice(index, 1)[0];
+  });
+  if (!challenge || challenge.expiresAt < Date.now()) throw new AuthError('This request expired. Please try again.');
+  return challenge;
+}

diff --git a/src/pages/api/auth/[...action].ts b/src/pages/api/auth/[...action].ts

--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/pages/api/auth/[...action].ts
@@ -0,0 +1,177 @@
+import type { APIRoute, APIContext } from 'astro';
+import {
+  generateRegistrationOptions, verifyRegistrationResponse,
+  generateAuthenticationOptions, verifyAuthenticationResponse,
+  type RegistrationResponseJSON, type AuthenticationResponseJSON,
+} from '@simplewebauthn/server';
+import { authTransaction } from '../../../lib/server/auth-store';
+import { AuthError, json, relyingParty, sameOrigin, requireUser, requireRecent,
+  signIn, rememberUser, passwordRequest, saveChallenge, takeChallenge } from '../../../lib/server/auth';
+import providers from '../../../lib/server/passkey-providers.json';
+
+const providerRegistry = providers as Record<string, { name: string; icon_light?: string }>;
+const nameValue = (value: unknown, label: string) => {
+  if (typeof value !== 'string' || !value.trim() || value.trim().length > 80) {
+    throw new AuthError(`${label} must contain 1–80 characters.`);
+  }
+  return value.trim();
+};
+
+async function account(context: APIContext) {
+  const user = await requireUser(context);
+  const passkeys = await authTransaction(store => store.passkeys.filter(p => p.userId === user.id).map(p => {
+    // Provider metadata is a display hint only; it is never an authorization input.
+    const provider = p.aaguid === '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' ? undefined : providerRegistry[p.aaguid];
+    return { id: p.id, name: p.name, provider: provider?.name || 'Unknown passkey provider',
+      providerIcon: provider?.icon_light, registeredAt: p.registeredAt, lastUsedAt: p.lastUsedAt, backedUp: p.backedUp };
+  }));
+  const verifiedAt = await context.session?.get('verifiedAt');
+  return { user, passkeys, rpId: relyingParty(context.request).rpId,
+    verifiedUntil: typeof verifiedAt === 'number' ? verifiedAt + 5 * 60_000 : 0 };
+}
+
+const handle: APIRoute = async context => {
+  try {
+    const { request, params, session } = context;
+    const action = params.action || '';
+    if (request.method === 'GET') {
+      if (action === 'account') return json(await account(context));
+      throw new AuthError('Endpoint not found.', 404);
+    }
+    sameOrigin(request);
+    const body = await request.json();
+    if (!body || typeof body !== 'object' || Array.isArray(body)) throw new AuthError('Invalid request.');
+    const { origin, rpId } = relyingParty(request);
+
+    if (request.method === 'POST' && ['login', 'signup', 'password/reauthenticate'].includes(action)) {
+      const reauth = action === 'password/reauthenticate';
+      const user = reauth ? await requireUser(context) : undefined;
+      const username = user?.username || nameValue(body.username, 'Username');
+      if (typeof body.password !== 'string' || !body.password || body.password.length > 1024) throw new AuthError('Enter your password.');
+      await passwordRequest(action === 'signup' ? 'register' : 'login', username, body.password);
+      if (reauth) {
+        session!.set('verifiedAt', Date.now());
+        return json({ verified: true });
+      }
+      const accountUser = await rememberUser(username);
+      await signIn(context, accountUser);
+      return json({ user: accountUser });
+    }
+    if (request.method === 'POST' && action === 'logout') {
+      session?.destroy();
+      return json({ success: true });
+    }
+
+    if (request.method === 'POST' && action === 'passkeys/register/options') {
+      const user = await requireUser(context);
+      await requireRecent(context);
+      const passkeys = await authTransaction(store => store.passkeys.filter(p => p.userId === user.id));
+      const options = await generateRegistrationOptions({
+        rpID: rpId, rpName: 'The DevTools Times', userID: Buffer.from(user.id, 'base64url'),
+        userName: user.username, userDisplayName: user.displayName, attestationType: 'none',
+        excludeCredentials: passkeys.map(p => ({ id: p.id, transports: p.transports })),
+        authenticatorSelection: { residentKey: 'required', requireResidentKey: true, userVerification: 'preferred',
+          ...(body.promotion === true ? { authenticatorAttachment: 'platform' as const } : {}) },
+      });
+      await saveChallenge(context, { challenge: options.challenge, purpose: 'register', userId: user.id,
+        rpId, origin, expiresAt: Date.now() + 5 * 60_000, requireUserVerification: false });
+      return json(options);
+    }
+    if (request.method === 'POST' && action === 'passkeys/register/verify') {
+      const user = await requireUser(context);
+      await requireRecent(context);
+      const challenge = await takeChallenge(context, 'register', body.challenge);
+      if (challenge.userId !== user.id) throw new AuthError('This registration belongs to another account.', 403);
+      let verification;
+      try {
+        verification = await verifyRegistrationResponse({ response: body.credential as RegistrationResponseJSON,
+          expectedChallenge: challenge.challenge, expectedOrigin: challenge.origin, expectedRPID: challenge.rpId,
+          requireUserVerification: challenge.requireUserVerification, requireUserPresence: true });
+      } catch { throw new AuthError('The passkey could not be verified. Please try again.'); }
+      if (!verification.verified) throw new AuthError('The passkey could not be verified.');
+      const info = verification.registrationInfo;
+      await authTransaction(store => {
+        if (store.passkeys.some(p => p.id === info.credential.id)) throw new AuthError('This passkey is already registered.', 409);
+        store.passkeys.push({ id: info.credential.id, userId: user.id,
+          publicKey: Buffer.from(info.credential.publicKey).toString('base64url'), counter: info.credential.counter,
+          transports: info.credential.transports, aaguid: info.aaguid,
+          name: body.name ? nameValue(body.name, 'Passkey name') : (providerRegistry[info.aaguid]?.name || 'My passkey'),
+          deviceType: info.credentialDeviceType, backedUp: info.credentialBackedUp, registeredAt: Date.now() });
+      });
+      return json(await account(context));
+    }
+
+    if (request.method === 'POST' && ['passkeys/authenticate/options', 'passkeys/reauthenticate/options'].includes(action)) {
+      const reauth = action.includes('/reauthenticate/');
+      const user = reauth ? await requireUser(context) : undefined;
+      const passkeys = user ? await authTransaction(store => store.passkeys.filter(p => p.userId === user.id)) : [];
+      if (reauth && !passkeys.length) throw new AuthError('No passkeys are registered. Verify with your password instead.');
+      const options = await generateAuthenticationOptions({ rpID: rpId,
+        allowCredentials: reauth ? passkeys.map(p => ({ id: p.id, transports: p.transports })) : [],
+        userVerification: reauth ? 'required' : 'preferred' });
+      await saveChallenge(context, { challenge: options.challenge, purpose: reauth ? 'reauthenticate' : 'authenticate',
+        userId: user?.id, rpId, origin, expiresAt: Date.now() + 5 * 60_000, requireUserVerification: reauth });
+      return json(options);
+    }
+    if (request.method === 'POST' && ['passkeys/authenticate/verify', 'passkeys/reauthenticate/verify'].includes(action)) {
+      const reauth = action.includes('/reauthenticate/');
+      const active = reauth ? await requireUser(context) : undefined;
+      const challenge = await takeChallenge(context, reauth ? 'reauthenticate' : 'authenticate', body.challenge);
+      if (reauth && challenge.userId !== active!.id) throw new AuthError('Please verify the signed-in account.', 403);
+      const credential = body.credential as AuthenticationResponseJSON;
+      const result = await authTransaction(async store => {
+        const stored = store.passkeys.find(p => p.id === credential?.id);
+        if (!stored) throw new AuthError('This passkey is no longer registered. Sign in with your password.', 404, 'UNKNOWN_CREDENTIAL');
+        if (reauth && stored.userId !== active!.id) throw new AuthError('Use a passkey for the signed-in account.', 403);
+        const owner = store.users.find(u => u.id === stored.userId);
+        if (!owner) throw new AuthError('Account not found.', 404);
+        if (credential.response.userHandle && credential.response.userHandle !== owner.id) throw new AuthError('The passkey account does not match.', 403);
+        let verification;
+        try {
+          verification = await verifyAuthenticationResponse({ response: credential,
+            expectedChallenge: challenge.challenge, expectedOrigin: challenge.origin, expectedRPID: challenge.rpId,
+            requireUserVerification: challenge.requireUserVerification,
+            credential: { id: stored.id, publicKey: Buffer.from(stored.publicKey, 'base64url'),
+              counter: stored.counter, transports: stored.transports } });
+        } catch { throw new AuthError('The passkey could not be verified. Please try again.', 400); }
+        if (!verification.verified) throw new AuthError('The passkey could not be verified.');
+        stored.counter = verification.authenticationInfo.newCounter;
+        stored.backedUp = verification.authenticationInfo.credentialBackedUp;
+        stored.lastUsedAt = Date.now();
+        return { user: owner, userVerified: verification.authenticationInfo.userVerified };
+      });
+      if (reauth) session!.set('verifiedAt', Date.now());
+      else await signIn(context, result.user, result.userVerified);
+      return json({ user: result.user, verified: true });
+    }
+
+    if (action === 'profile' && request.method === 'PATCH') {
+      const user = await requireUser(context);
+      await requireRecent(context);
+      const displayName = nameValue(body.displayName, 'Display name');
+      await authTransaction(store => { store.users.find(u => u.id === user.id)!.displayName = displayName; });
+      return json(await account(context));
+    }
+    if (action === 'passkeys' && ['PATCH', 'DELETE'].includes(request.method)) {
+      const user = await requireUser(context);
+      await requireRecent(context);
+      await authTransaction(store => {
+        const index = store.passkeys.findIndex(p => p.id === body.id && p.userId === user.id);
+        if (index < 0) throw new AuthError('Passkey not found.', 404);
+        if (request.method === 'DELETE') store.passkeys.splice(index, 1);
+        else store.passkeys[index].name = nameValue(body.name, 'Passkey name');
+      });
+      return json(await account(context));
+    }
+    throw new AuthError('Endpoint not found.', 404);
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (error instanceof AuthError) return json({ error: error.message, code: error.code }, error.status);
+    if (error instanceof SyntaxError) return json({ error: 'Invalid request.' }, 400);
+    console.error('Authentication request failed:', error);
+    return json({ error: 'Something went wrong. Please try again.' }, 500);
+  }
+};
+export const GET = handle;
+export const POST = handle;
+export const PATCH = handle;
+export const DELETE = handle;

+# Homepage authentication integration
+
+`index.html` uses the bundled `src/auth.js` client. Run `pnpm install` and
+`pnpm build` after changing that source. The committed `auth.bundle.js` lets the
+homepage run on the existing static host without starting another server.
+
+This repository contains no account database or authentication service. Real
+sign-in requires these same-origin HTTPS endpoints; the client does not simulate
+successful authentication or save credentials in browser storage.
+
+| Endpoint | Request | Successful response |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `GET /api/login/session` | Existing session cookie | JSON `{ "authenticated": true }` or `{ "authenticated": false }` |
+| `POST /api/login/options` | JSON `{}` | WebAuthn request options as JSON, with a Base64URL challenge, configured `rpId`, `userVerification: "preferred"`, and omitted or empty `allowCredentials` |
+| `POST /api/login/verify` | Assertion serialized with `credential.toJSON()` | Establish session cookie; JSON `{ "authenticated": true }` |
+| `POST /api/login/password` | JSON `{ "username": "…", "password": "…" }` | Verify password, establish session cookie; JSON `{ "authenticated": true }` |
+| `POST /api/logout` | JSON `{}` | Invalidate session cookie; successful HTTP status |
+
+Generate cryptographically random, single-use, session-bound challenges on the
+server. They must remain valid for at least the client's 60-second options cache
+plus the credential interaction. Persist expected user verification server-side.
+Use a vetted WebAuthn server library to validate the challenge, origin, RP ID,
+signature, and verification requirements against registered credentials. Only
+return HTTP 404 from the assertion verification endpoint when the credential is
+actually unknown; that response triggers optional password-manager synchronization.
+Return other failures as non-2xx statuses. Never redirect these API requests to a
+login page. Use `Cache-Control: no-store` on all authentication responses.
+
+Protect state-changing endpoints against CSRF by validating the same-origin
+`Origin` header and rejecting cross-origin and non-JSON requests. Set secure,
+HttpOnly, SameSite session cookies and rotate sessions after login. Rate-limit
+credential attempts and return generic password errors. The Rewards, Account,
+and Order destinations must enforce authentication on the server independently
+of the homepage's UI state.
+
+Quick sign-in is initiated only by an ordinary link click, after checking
+`capabilities.immediateGet`; it requests both saved passwords and passkeys with
+`uiMode: 'immediate'`, without an AbortSignal or credential allowlist. Options
+and capabilities are preloaded so the credential request can run within the
+click's transient activation. If options are unavailable or stale, the browser
+is unsupported, no local account exists, or the chooser is dismissed, the inline
+form opens without navigating. An expired challenge or verification failure
+also keeps the customer on the page. Modified clicks retain native link behavior.
+
+The form supports password autofill, conditional passkey autofill, an explicit
+passkey button that permits phone/security-key options, and Keep browsing. A
+pending conditional request is aborted before another credential request or
+password submission. Successful sign-in updates the current page, then resumes
+the selected Rewards, My Account, or Order Now destination if there was one.
