--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/auth.js
@@ -0,0 +1,258 @@
+import 'webauthn-polyfills';
+
+// API contract: see AUTHENTICATION.md. Only a verified server session signs a user in.
+const form = document.querySelector('#signin-form');
+const status = document.querySelector('#signin-status');
+const passkeyButton = document.querySelector('#passkey-signin');
+const password = document.querySelector('#password');
+let signedIn = false;
+let busy = false;
+let destination = null;
+let opener = null;
+let capabilities = {};
+let cachedOptions = null;
+let optionsTime = 0;
+let optionsPromise = null;
+let conditionalController = null;
+
+async function post(path, body) {
+  return fetch(path, {
+    method: 'POST', credentials: 'same-origin', cache: 'no-store', redirect: 'error',
+    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Accept: 'application/json' },
+    body: JSON.stringify(body ?? {}),
+  });
+}
+
+async function getOptions() {
+  if (cachedOptions && Date.now() - optionsTime < 60000) return cachedOptions;
+  if (optionsPromise) return optionsPromise;
+  optionsPromise = fetchOptions();
+  try { return await optionsPromise; }
+  finally { optionsPromise = null; }
+}
+
+async function fetchOptions() {
+  const response = await post('/api/login/options');
+  if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.');
+  const options = await response.json();
+  // Quick sign-in uses discoverable credentials, never an account-specific allowlist.
+  if (options.allowCredentials?.length) throw new Error('Unable to start sign-in. Please try again later.');
+  cachedOptions = PublicKeyCredential.parseRequestOptionsFromJSON(options);
+  optionsTime = Date.now();
+  return cachedOptions;
+}
+
+function stopConditional() {
+  conditionalController?.abort();
+  conditionalController = null;
+}
+
+function setBusy(value) {
+  busy = value;
+  form.setAttribute('aria-busy', String(value));
+  form.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(button => { button.disabled = value; });
+}
+
+function updateSession(value) {
+  signedIn = value;
+  document.querySelector('#header-signin').hidden = value;
+  document.querySelector('#signin-trigger').hidden = value;
+  document.querySelector('#logout-item').hidden = !value;
+  document.querySelector('#signin-heading').textContent = value ? 'Welcome back. You’re signed in.' : 'Welcome back to your daily ritual';
+  document.querySelector('#signin-description').textContent = value
+    ? 'Your rewards, account, and next order are ready when you are.'
+    : 'Sign in with a saved passkey or password for your rewards and your next order.';
+}
+
+function completeSignIn() {
+  stopConditional();
+  cachedOptions = null;
+  updateSession(true);
+  form.reset();
+  form.hidden = true;
+  password.type = 'password';
+  document.querySelector('#toggle-password').textContent = 'Show password';
+  document.querySelector('#toggle-password').setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
+  status.textContent = 'You’re signed in. Enjoy your daily grind!';
+  if (destination) window.location.assign(destination);
+  else {
+    const heading = document.querySelector('#signin-heading');
+    heading.tabIndex = -1;
+    heading.focus({ preventScroll: true });
+  }
+  destination = null;
+}
+
+async function verify(credential, publicKey) {
+  if (!credential) throw new DOMException('No saved credential selected', 'NotAllowedError');
+  cachedOptions = null;
+  let response;
+  if (credential.type === 'public-key') {
+    const encoded = credential.toJSON();
+    response = await post('/api/login/verify', encoded);
+    if (response.status === 404 && PublicKeyCredential.signalUnknownCredential) {
+      // Synchronization is optional and must not mask the verification error.
+      await PublicKeyCredential.signalUnknownCredential({
+        rpId: publicKey.rpId || location.hostname, credentialId: encoded.id,
+      }).catch(() => {});
+    }
+  } else if (credential.type === 'password') {
+    response = await post('/api/login/password', { username: credential.id, password: credential.password });
+  } else throw new Error('Please sign in with your email and password.');
+  if (!response.ok) throw new Error('We couldn’t sign you in. Try your email and password or another passkey.');
+  if ((await response.json()).authenticated !== true) throw new Error('Sign-in could not be confirmed. Please try again.');
+  completeSignIn();
+}
+
+async function startConditional() {
+  if (!capabilities.conditionalGet || signedIn || busy || form.hidden) return;
+  stopConditional();
+  const controller = new AbortController();
+  conditionalController = controller;
+  try {
+    const publicKey = await getOptions();
+    if (controller.signal.aborted || form.hidden || busy) return;
+    const credential = await navigator.credentials.get({
+      publicKey, mediation: 'conditional', signal: controller.signal,
+    });
+    if (controller.signal.aborted || busy) return;
+    setBusy(true);
+    try { await verify(credential, publicKey); }
+    finally { setBusy(false); }
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (!['AbortError', 'NotAllowedError'].includes(error.name) && !controller.signal.aborted) {
+      status.textContent = 'Saved passkeys are unavailable right now. You can still try your email and password.';
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+function showForm(message = '') {
+  form.hidden = false;
+  status.textContent = message;
+  document.querySelector('#username').focus({ preventScroll: true });
+  form.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', behavior: 'instant' });
+  void startConditional();
+}
+
+document.querySelectorAll('[data-auth]').forEach(link => {
+  link.addEventListener('click', async event => {
+    // Preserve normal new-tab, download, and modified-click link behavior.
+    if (event.button !== 0 || event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey || event.shiftKey || event.altKey) return;
+    if (signedIn) return;
+    event.preventDefault();
+    if (busy) return;
+    opener = link;
+    destination = link.hash === '#signin' ? null : link.getAttribute('href');
+    stopConditional();
+    // Preload support/options while browsing, so no network wait loses click activation.
+    if (!capabilities.immediateGet || !cachedOptions || Date.now() - optionsTime > 60000) {
+      showForm();
+      return;
+    }
+    setBusy(true);
+    status.textContent = 'Choose a saved account to sign in.';
+    try {
+      const publicKey = cachedOptions;
+      const credential = await navigator.credentials.get({
+        publicKey, password: true, uiMode: 'immediate',
+        // Immediate UI forbids an AbortSignal and a nonempty allowCredentials list.
+      });
+      await verify(credential, publicKey);
+    } catch (error) {
+      showForm(error.name === 'NotAllowedError' ? 'Choose another sign-in method below, or keep browsing.'
+        : 'We couldn’t complete quick sign-in. Try another method below.');
+    } finally {
+      setBusy(false);
+      if (!form.hidden) void startConditional();
+    }
+  });
+});
+
+form.addEventListener('submit', async event => {
+  event.preventDefault();
+  if (busy) return;
+  stopConditional();
+  setBusy(true);
+  status.textContent = 'Signing you in…';
+  try {
+    const response = await post(form.getAttribute('action'), {
+      username: form.elements.username.value, password: password.value,
+    });
+    if (!response.ok) throw new Error('We couldn’t sign you in. Check your details and try again.');
+    if ((await response.json()).authenticated !== true) throw new Error('Sign-in could not be confirmed. Please try again.');
+    completeSignIn();
+  } catch (error) {
+    status.textContent = error instanceof TypeError ? 'Unable to reach sign-in. Please try again.' : error.message;
+  } finally { setBusy(false); }
+});
+
+passkeyButton.addEventListener('click', async () => {
+  if (busy) return;
+  stopConditional();
+  setBusy(true);
+  status.textContent = 'Choose a passkey to sign in.';
+  try {
+    const publicKey = await getOptions();
+    // Explicit fallback permits phone/QR/security-key options; never use immediate here.
+    const credential = await navigator.credentials.get({ publicKey });
+    await verify(credential, publicKey);
+  } catch (error) {
+    status.textContent = error.name === 'NotAllowedError'
+      ? 'Passkey sign-in was cancelled. Try again or use your password.'
+      : 'Passkey sign-in is unavailable right now. Try your email and password.';
+  } finally {
+    setBusy(false);
+    if (!form.hidden) void startConditional();
+  }
+});
+
+document.querySelector('#toggle-password').addEventListener('click', event => {
+  const visible = password.type === 'password';
+  password.type = visible ? 'text' : 'password';
+  event.currentTarget.textContent = visible ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password';
+  event.currentTarget.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(visible));
+});
+
+document.querySelector('#cancel-signin').addEventListener('click', () => {
+  stopConditional();
+  destination = null;
+  form.hidden = true;
+  status.textContent = '';
+  password.value = '';
+  password.type = 'password';
+  document.querySelector('#toggle-password').textContent = 'Show password';
+  document.querySelector('#toggle-password').setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
+  opener?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
+});
+
+document.querySelector('#logout').addEventListener('click', async event => {
+  if (busy) return;
+  const button = event.currentTarget;
+  button.disabled = true;
+  setBusy(true);
+  try {
+    const response = await post('/api/logout');
+    if (!response.ok) throw new Error();
+    updateSession(false);
+    cachedOptions = null;
+    status.textContent = 'You’re signed out.';
+    document.querySelector('#header-signin').focus();
+    if (window.PublicKeyCredential && navigator.credentials) void getOptions().catch(() => {});
+  } catch { status.textContent = 'Unable to sign out. Please try again.'; }
+  finally { button.disabled = false; setBusy(false); }
+});
+
+async function initialize() {
+  // Session restoration is advisory for UI only; destinations enforce sessions server-side.
+  try {
+    const response = await fetch('/api/login/session', { credentials: 'same-origin', cache: 'no-store', redirect: 'error', headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } });
+    if (response.ok && (await response.json()).authenticated === true) updateSession(true);
+  } catch { /* Browsing and the inline form remain available. */ }
+  if (!window.isSecureContext || !window.PublicKeyCredential || !navigator.credentials || signedIn) return;
+  passkeyButton.hidden = false;
+  try { capabilities = await PublicKeyCredential.getClientCapabilities(); }
+  catch { capabilities = {}; }
+  try { await getOptions(); } catch { /* Inline password sign-in remains available. */ }
+  if (!form.hidden) void startConditional();
+}
+void initialize();
